name: Depressive Symptoms
description: Pattern related to low energy, reduced motivation, or feeling emotionally weighed down.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. If persistent low mood or hopelessness continues, please consult a healthcare professional.

solutions.title: Tiny-Step Activity
solutions.purpose: Help the user choose one very small achievable action rather than presenting a large task.

solutions.title: Guided Breathing
instructions: Rest in a comfortable position without any pressure.
Breathe in gently for a count of 4.
Breathe out slowly for a count of 6.
Allow your body to sink comfortably into support.

solutions.title: Guided Meditation
instructions: Bring warm awareness to your heart and chest.
Remind yourself that taking things one moment at a time is enough.
Rest quietly until the timer finishes.

solutions.title: Gentle Movement / Walk
solutions.purpose: Encourage a small, manageable period of movement.
instructions: Take a slow 5 to 10 minute walk indoors or outdoors.
Notice the physical sensation of stepping forward.
If walking isn't practical, stretch your arms and torso gently.
Praise yourself for taking this physical step.

solutions.title: Mind-Clearing / Reflection
solutions.purpose: Give the user a structured quiet reflection activity.
instructions: Reflect on one thing, no matter how small, that brought a moment of peace.
Allow yourself to just be here right now without needing to fix anything.
